FEATURE.description: New user-visible behaviour or a new capability.

FIX.description: Repair a defect without changing the public contract.

SECURITY.description: Close an authorization, money, session, or injection defect.

DOC.description: Documentation-only change with no executable behaviour.
DOC.allowed_rule: EVERY diff path MUST match an allowed_path_globs entry AND MUST NOT match denied_extensions AND MUST NOT match denied_path_globs EXCEPT the backend/docs/** docs exception (backend/docs/**/*.md|rst|txt and **/docs/**/*.md|rst|txt override the backend/** deny; **/*.py overrides everything, including backend/docs/**)
DOC.backend_docs_note: docs/ lives inside backend/ (backend/docs/), NOT at repo root. backend/** is denied under DOC EXCEPT backend/docs/** docs: backend/docs/** is allowed ONLY with .md/.rst/.txt extensions (covered by **/docs/**/*.md|rst|txt and **/*.md|rst|txt). A .py under backend/docs/ is REJECTED.
DOC.enforcement_layer: policy fields (this file + task-limits.json) are authoritative; orchestrator/builder must declare capability.scope from allowed_path_globs and every diff path is checked against them. gate_run.py DOC path rejection is NOT in this patch (owned scope is check_test_set only); SCOPE check enforces scope membership.

INFRA.description: Build, CI, deployment, dependency, or runtime configuration change.

DRAIN.description: Cluster and drain a backlog of reproduced defects, five rows per capability.
